title: Vista Del Mare | KEY.co
meta_description: Refined beach living near Walton Dunes
description_expanded: Spanning four thoughtfully designed levels, the home offers both space and flexibility for groups. The first floor features a queen guest suite with a private ensuite bath, along with a secondary living area that opens directly to the private pool. The second level includes two king bedrooms sharing a well-appointed bathroom, each with balcony access, as well as a bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunks and its own ensuite bath, ideal for younger guests. The top floor is dedicated to a private primary retreat, complete with a king bed, wet bar, private balcony, and a spa-inspired ensuite with marble finishes, creating a true sanctuary within the home. At the heart of the home, the third floor living space is designed for gathering and entertaining. A gourmet kitchen with Italian marble countertops and a waterfall island anchors the open-concept layout, flowing seamlessly into the dining and living areas and out onto a Gulf-facing balcony. Outdoors, a private pool offers a refreshing escape, while multiple balconies invite moments of relaxation throughout the day. With elevator access to all levels, five included beach cruiser bikes, and close proximity to the beach and 30A’s best dining and shopping, this home delivers a seamless, elevated coastal experience.
